name: spellkave_self_states
label: Spellkave Self Sheet
description: Page through the connected actor's authorized state pools, conditions, capabilities, identity facets, recent evaluation history, or action-economy channel spends. Use kind=condition for condition continuation, kind=capability for the actor's own trained/granted capabilities, kind=identity for the actor's own species/class/background tags (static session-entry detail, with descriptions where the world declared them; fetch this once at session start rather than on every turn), kind=evaluation for the actor's own recent check outcomes (status and any resolved rolls — e.g. what a check rolled), most-recent-first, kind=economy for the actor's own action-economy channel standing (per channel: current-window spent_ms/window_start_ms, plus the last spend's cost_ms/remaining_ms — "how much of my turn is left"). State rows support authored state-id prefix and exact resource-tag filters. Evaluation rows support an exact provenance_id filter to look up a specific record (e.g. from an act receipt). Use next_cursor to continue.

kind.description: Self-sheet row kind. Defaults to state.

state_prefix.description: Exact state_id prefix filter; valid only for kind=state.

state_tag.description: Exact authored resource tag filter; valid only for kind=state.

provenance_id.description: Exact provenance_id filter; valid only for kind=evaluation. Returns matched 1 and the row, or matched 0.

cursor.description: Opaque next_cursor from the prior page.
